steps.title: Reject below-half-millisecond and accept final source millisecond
preconditions: Run tests/e2e/journeys/audio-library.mjs --group timing-boundaries in fresh isolated automation app storage. Native execution results are recorded separately in docs/testing/coverage-goal-20261113.md. Existing imported synthetic four-second PCM is the sole clip. Readiness observations may repeat.
Claims concern persisted metadata and UIKit control state. Device output, playback position, waveform geometry, drawing, dragging, races and storage faults are outside this catalog.

import-audio {base64: syntheticPCM().toString("base64"), attachment: "selected-dialogue"}
activate {target: observed Audio library control}; activate {target: audio-clip-trim-<imported clip ID>}
text {target: audio-source-in, text: "3.999"}; text {target: audio-duration, text: "0.00049"}; text {target: audio-placement-offset, text: "0.000"}; activate {target: audio-apply}; persisted-projects

text {target: audio-source-in, text: "3.999"}; text {target: audio-duration, text: "0.0005"}; text {target: audio-placement-offset, text: "86400.001"}; activate {target: audio-apply}; persisted-projects

activate {target: audio-clip-trim-<imported clip ID>}; text {target: audio-placement-offset, text: "0.000"}; activate {target: audio-apply}; persisted-projects; snapshot

expectations.description: The 0.00049-second duration remains an unapplied draft with unchanged persisted packages. At 0.0005 seconds the saved clip has exactly durationMs 1, sourceStartMs 3999 and startMs 86400000. An offset of 86400.001 seconds is rejected and 86400.000 is accepted. Whole-model revision comparison catches unrelated edits.

expectations.description: Maximum accepted placement displays the explicit after-scene editor warning, then Outside scene and a disabled sole clip play control in the library. Reopening retains canonical 0.001-second duration and 86400.000-second offset. Restoring offset zero creates exactly one saved revision and enables the existing play control. Playback is never activated.
